purpose: Target leakage matrix for the five Stage 1B candidates, predeclared before any Stage-2 training.

GalaxyPPG_HR.galaxy_watch5_acc: CONTEXT_ONLY (not part of the frozen A/B/C; could motivate a future ablation but is not in scope)
GalaxyPPG_HR.activity_label: CONTEXT_ONLY (used for subgroup/activity-sensitivity reporting, Section 25, never as a model input feature)
GalaxyPPG_HR.skin_temperature: UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW (not part of the frozen A/B/C; P02 missing this signal per the paper - excluded from scope entirely rather than reviewed further)

HMC_sleep.emg_chin: EXCLUDE_LEAKAGE (chin EMG can directly encode REM atonia / arousal - would make the sleep-stage target partially circular if included; excluded from the frozen A/B/C exactly as this project's Sleep-EDF experiments already exclude non-EEG/EOG channels)
HMC_sleep.ecg_lead_ii: EXCLUDE_LEAKAGE (same reasoning - cardiac-rate variation correlates with sleep stage and is not the signal under test)
HMC_sleep.subject_id_recording_id: GROUPING_ONLY (151 unique subjects, one recording each - confirmed no repeat-night grouping issue exists for this database, unlike the master prompt's generic warning)

QDE_bodymass_change.inbody_weight: EXCLUDE_CIRCULARITY (same BIA device family as the impedance features - see qde_v2_protocol_stage1b.json for the full circularity analysis)
QDE_bodymass_change.inbody_tbw: EXCLUDE_CIRCULARITY (this was the OLD target; now explicitly excluded as an input to the NEW target to avoid target leakage between the historical and new experiments)
QDE_bodymass_change.running_interval_0_to_8: EXCLUDE_LEAKAGE (directly encodes elapsed protocol time - equivalent to the master prompt's 'elapsed time' / 'exercise interval' exclusion)
QDE_bodymass_change.skin_temperature_11_sites: SAFE_INPUT (available but NOT part of the frozen A/B/C feature set - out of scope, not excluded for leakage reasons)
QDE_bodymass_change.sweat_saliva_biomarkers: CONTEXT_ONLY (not part of the frozen A/B/C; a real but out-of-scope modality in the same file)

LBNP_stage.filename_or_recording_timestamp: EXCLUDE_LEAKAGE (must be verified absent from the feature array once raw files are actually accessed in Stage 2 - flagged as a mandatory Stage-2 pre-training check, since this sprint could not directly inspect the raw filenames - Zenodo access blocked)
LBNP_stage.abdominal_arm_eis_spectrum: CONTEXT_ONLY (not part of the frozen A/B/C - only the thoracic site is used, per Section 13's single-site focus to keep A/B/C a single-variable comparison)
LBNP_stage.map_invasive: EXCLUDE_LEAKAGE from the PRIMARY experiment (LBNP-stage target); usable ONLY as a separate, preregistered SECONDARY target per Section 13, in which case pressure-level itself must then be excluded from that secondary experiment's inputs

ds003838_memory_load.condition_control_vs_memory: CONTEXT_ONLY (a real, separate axis from sequence length; not conflated with the length target - could motivate a secondary/interaction analysis but is out of scope for the frozen primary A/B/C)
ds003838_memory_load.eeg_63_channels: SAFE_INPUT (sparse subset = A, full montage = B, per the frozen channel selection)
ds003838_memory_load.recall_correctness_behavioral: CONTEXT_ONLY (post-hoc performance measure, not part of the input feature set - could trivially leak load-dependent difficulty, excluded from inputs)
ds003838_memory_load.trigger_code_per_digit_position: EXCLUDE_LEAKAGE if used naively (the trigger code strings directly encode the sequence length digit-by-digit, e.g. 'x500105' vs 'x500113' - the LOADER must extract only the windowed EEG epoch and the associated condition label, never pass the raw trigger-code string as a feature)
ds003838_memory_load.nasa_tlx_scores: CONTEXT_ONLY (subjective workload ratings in participants.tsv; not the primary target per Section 14's instruction to prefer the externally-imposed condition)
